en.commentary:
I ranked these ten on one question: which case still rolls straight and still clears a gate sizer after four years of real flying. The Travelpro Platinum Elite 21 takes the top spot because it wins the part of the trip your hand is touching every minute. Its MagnaTrac wheels align themselves magnetically, and in OutdoorGearLab's 2026 test it took perfect marks for both tracking and wheel smoothness on the way to an overall 92, the highest score in the field. It lists at $390, drops near $300 several times a year, and carries a lifetime warranty on the wheels, zippers and handles.

The bigger story of 2026 is the EU cabin standard. Every passenger flying in the EU is now entitled to one cabin bag of 55 x 40 x 20 cm plus a 40 x 30 x 15 cm personal item, carried free as part of the fare, and those numbers include wheels and handles. That last clause reshapes the category. American carry-ons are built 9 inches deep, which converts to 22.9 cm, so depth is where the entire US market sits outside the guaranteed band. I made cabin size compliance its own scoring factor for exactly that reason, and it is why the Calpak Ambeur at 53.3 x 34.9 x 22.9 cm and the Away Carry-On at 55.1 x 36.6 x 22.9 cm lead the field on that axis.

Value splits sharply once you pass $500. Briggs & Riley earns its perfect durability score with an unconditional lifetime repair policy that covers airline damage and asks for no receipt. Rimowa gives you a 3.2 kg shell, a lifetime warranty and real service counters in Taipei for $900. Samsonite's Freeform delivers 41.2 liters at a measured 6.6 lb for around $150, the strongest money-per-liter result anywhere in this test.

highlights.title: The EU's 55 x 40 x 20 cm rule is now the only cabin number worth memorising
highlights.body: As of July 2026 every passenger on an EU flight is entitled to one cabin bag of 55 x 40 x 20 cm and one personal item of 40 x 30 x 15 cm, carried free as part of the ticket price. The measurement includes wheels and handles, and that is the detail most shoppers miss. A US carry-on is built 9 inches deep, which is 22.9 cm, so depth is the dimension that decides whether your bag is guaranteed or merely tolerated. I scored this as its own factor because a suitcase that clears the sizer is worth more than one with a nicer lining.

highlights.title: Travelpro takes first because wheels are the component your hand feels every minute
highlights.body: MagnaTrac wheels use magnets to pull themselves back into line whenever the case starts to wander, which is why the Platinum Elite earned perfect scores for tracking and smoothness in OutdoorGearLab's 2026 testing and finished with an overall 92, the highest in a field of more than twenty cases. The lifetime limited warranty covers wheels, zippers and handles, the three parts that actually end a suitcase's life. At $390 list and near $300 on sale, this is the case I would hand to someone who flies more than six times a year.

highlights.title: Briggs & Riley's Simple as That guarantee is the strongest repair promise in luggage
highlights.body: The policy repairs functional damage for life at no charge, covers damage caused by airlines, and asks for no proof of purchase. That is why I gave it the only perfect durability score here. The ballistic nylon body pairs with CX compression-expansion that adds 2.5 inches of depth when you need it and compresses back down flat afterwards. At $729 and 10 lb it asks a lot up front, and it repays anyone who plans to own one suitcase for the next fifteen years.

highlights.title: Samsonite's Freeform is the best money-per-liter result in this entire test
highlights.body: 41.2 liters at a measured 6.6 lb is the strongest capacity-to-weight ratio of the ten, and it took an OutdoorGearLab Best Buy award on that basis. List price is $220 and it sits near $150 for much of the year, which puts it at roughly a third of what the DTC hardsides charge for a similar volume. Anyone buying a first hardside carry-on, or a second case for a family that only flies twice a year, should start here.

highlights.title: A front pocket deep enough for a 16-inch laptop changes how you move through security
highlights.body: The Monos Carry-On Pro and the July Carry On both solve the same daily annoyance in different ways. Monos puts a full external pocket on the face of the shell so a 16-inch laptop, passport and charger come out while the case stays upright. July builds in an ejectable USB-C power bank and a CaseSafe tracker that pairs with Apple Find My and Android Find Hub. Both sit at $295 with lifetime warranties, and both are the right answer for anyone whose carry-on doubles as a work bag.

zh-tw.commentary:
老實說，登機箱這個品類我看了很多年，今年終於出現一個值得重新排一次的理由。歐盟今年七月通過的隨身行李標準化，把 55x40x20 公分直接寫進票價裡，搭歐盟航線的每個人都保證能免費帶一個這個尺寸的登機箱，外加一個 40x30x15 公分的隨身小包。重點在後面那一句，這個尺寸是含輪子跟拉桿一起量的。

美規登機箱的厚度標準是 9 吋，換算 22.9 公分，這代表整個美國市場的箱子在厚度這一項全部站在保證範圍的外面。所以我這次特地把「尺寸合規」拉出來當一個獨立評分項，Calpak Ambeur 的 53.3 x 34.9 x 22.9 公分跟 Away Carry-On 的 55.1 x 36.6 x 22.9 公分在這一項明顯領先全場。

第一名我給 Travelpro Platinum Elite 21 吋，理由很單純，你每一分鐘手上碰的就是輪子跟拉桿。這台的 MagnaTrac 輪組會磁吸自動對正，OutdoorGearLab 2026 年實測給它循跡性跟滑順度雙滿分、總分 92 分全場最高。定價 390 美金換算大概 NT$11,800，一年好幾次特價會掉到 300 美金上下，輪子、拉鍊、拉桿保固終身。

講白了，台灣人買登機箱最常見的就兩種情境。一種是桃園飛東京大阪那種三到五天的自由行，你要的是好推好塞、丟上頭頂行李櫃不費力；另一種是飛歐洲自助再轉廉航，你要的是站在登機口量測架前面能一次過。這兩種需求在這份榜單裡剛好落在不同位置，我在每一台的推薦理由裡都寫清楚了。

highlights.title: 歐盟 55 x 40 x 20 公分這組數字，今年開始是唯一要背起來的尺寸
highlights.body: 2026 年七月起，搭歐盟航線的每位旅客都保證可以免費帶一個 55 x 40 x 20 公分的登機箱，加一個 40 x 30 x 15 公分的隨身小包，費用已經含在機票裡。關鍵細節是這個尺寸含輪子跟拉桿一起量，大部分人買的時候都會漏掉這一點。美規登機箱厚度做 9 吋，換算 22.9 公分，所以厚度就是決定你的箱子是「保證帶得上去」還是「看櫃檯心情」的那一項。我把它獨立拉出來評分，因為過得了量測架的箱子，價值遠高於內裡做得漂亮的箱子。

highlights.title: Travelpro 拿第一，是因為輪子才是你每一分鐘都在感受的零件
highlights.body: MagnaTrac 輪組用磁力把偏掉的輪子拉回正位，這也是為什麼 Platinum Elite 在 OutdoorGearLab 2026 年實測拿到循跡性跟滑順度雙滿分，總分 92 分在二十多台裡最高。終身保固涵蓋輪子、拉鍊、拉桿這三個真正會終結一咖行李箱壽命的零件。定價 390 美金、特價落在 300 美金上下，換算下來大概 NT$9,000 到 NT$11,800 這個區間，一年飛超過六趟的人我就直接推這台。

highlights.title: Briggs & Riley 的 Simple as That 保固是行李箱界最硬的一張保單
highlights.body: 這張保單終身免費修復功能性損壞，連航空公司弄壞的也照修，而且不需要出示購買證明，這是我這次唯一給出耐用度滿分的原因。彈道尼龍箱體搭配 CX 壓縮擴充結構，需要的時候能再多撐開 6 公分厚度，收起來又能壓回平整。729 美金換算超過 NT$22,000，等於一台入門筆電的價格，重量也來到 10 磅。這台適合打算未來十五年只用同一咖行李箱的人。

highlights.title: Samsonite Freeform 是這份榜單裡每一塊錢換到最多容量的一台
highlights.body: 實測 6.6 磅裝得下 41.2 公升，重量容量比是十台裡面最好的，OutdoorGearLab 也因此頒給它 Best Buy。定價 220 美金，一年多數時間落在 150 美金上下，換算大約 NT$4,500 到 NT$6,600，差不多是那些網路直營硬殼品牌同容量價格的三分之一。第一次買硬殼登機箱的人，或是家裡一年只飛兩趟需要添第二咖的人，從這台開始看就對了。

highlights.title: 前開口袋能吃下 16 吋筆電，過安檢的體驗會完全不一樣
highlights.body: Monos Carry-On Pro 跟 July Carry On 用兩種方式處理同一個日常痛點。Monos 直接在殼面上做一個完整的外掛口袋，16 吋筆電、護照、充電器都能在箱子站著的狀態下抽出來，桃園機場安檢排隊那條線上這一秒鐘差很多。July 則是內建可彈出式 USB-C 行動電源，加上一顆同時支援 Apple Find My 跟 Android Find Hub 的 CaseSafe 追蹤器。兩台都是 295 美金、換算約 NT$8,900，也都給終身保固，登機箱同時當公事包用的人選這兩台準沒錯。

en.commentary: Travelpro Platinum Elite 21 holds first at 8.9 and the reason is the wheels, which is where carry-on luggage actually fails. Cases rarely crack. Wheels seize, and telescoping handles bend and stick, and once either happens the bag is finished regardless of how good the shell is. The Platinum Elite's MagnaTrac magnetic self-aligning wheels are the only genuinely differentiated wheel design in this category, and Travelpro's warranty on the wheel and handle assemblies reflects real confidence rather than marketing. Third-party stress testing across repeated flight cycles consistently places this bag ahead on ten year durability, which directly contradicts the newer direct-to-consumer marketing narrative. Away The Carry-On second at 8.6 rolls nearly as well while weighing less, which matters when airlines enforce a 7 to 10kg cabin allowance and every 100 grams of empty weight is 100 grams of belongings you cannot bring. Monos Carry-On Pro third at 8.5 has the external front pocket that fits a 16 inch laptop, which is the feature most business travellers rank first. For readers flying from Taiwan, the practical point is that Tigerair, Peach, and Scoot each apply different size and weight limits, and the strictest of them is what should determine your purchase. Check the specific airlines you fly rather than a generic international standard, and weigh the empty case before you pack. No rank or score changes today.

Travelpro's MagnaTrac magnetic self-aligning wheels are the only genuinely differentiated wheel design here, and third-party stress testing across repeated flight cycles places this bag ahead on ten year durability. That is the basis of 8.9.

A bag that clears one carrier and fails another costs you a gate fee every time. Look up the actual figures for your routes before choosing a size.

highlights.title: A front laptop pocket changes the security queue
highlights.body: The Monos Carry-On Pro's external pocket fits a 16 inch laptop, which means removing it for screening does not involve opening the whole case on a bench. For anyone travelling for work weekly, that single design decision saves genuine friction on every trip, and it is why business travellers rank it first.

en.commentary:
The 2026 size picture is now clear enough to shop against, and it explains the compliance column on this board better than any review does. Most US carriers including Delta, United, American, Alaska and JetBlue cap cabin bags at 22 by 14 by 9 inches. Southwest and Frontier are more generous at 24 by 16 by 10. European budget airlines run much tighter, with some capping at 21.5 by 15.5 by 7.5 inches, and Asian carriers frequently enforce a weight limit of 15 to 22 pounds regardless of how well the bag fits the sizer.

That last point deserves emphasis for anyone flying regional routes out of Asia, because the weigh in happens at the counter and a bag that passed the sizer still gets checked if it is over. On a 7 kilogram allowance, a shell that weighs 4 kilograms before you pack it leaves you 3 kilograms of clothes.

The Travelpro Platinum Elite 21 inch holds first at 8.9. Wheels at 9.8 and durability at 9.5 are the reason, and OutdoorGearLab has kept it as a tested favourite across many years of updates, which is the kind of longevity signal I trust. Its compliance score of 6.8 is the honest counterweight, since the expandable section pushes it past strict sizers when you use it.

Away The Carry-On holds second at 8.6 with the best balance of compliance at 8.2 and capacity at 8.8. Briggs & Riley Baseline Essential stays fifth at 8.3 on a perfect 10 for durability, backed by the lifetime warranty that covers airline damage. No rank or score changes today.

highlights.title: 22 by 14 by 9 inches is the number to design around
highlights.body: Delta, United, American, Alaska and JetBlue all cap cabin bags at 22 by 14 by 9 inches, Southwest and Frontier allow 24 by 16 by 10, and some European budget carriers go as tight as 21.5 by 15.5 by 7.5. Buy for the strictest airline you fly regularly.

highlights.title: Asian carriers weigh the bag, so empty weight is capacity
highlights.body: Weight limits of 15 to 22 pounds are common on Asian routes and they are enforced at the counter regardless of whether the bag fits the sizer. Against a 7 kilogram allowance, every kilogram the empty shell weighs is a kilogram of clothes you cannot bring.

highlights.title: Expansion zips buy volume and spend compliance
highlights.body: The Travelpro Platinum Elite scores 9.2 for capacity and 6.8 for compliance, and those two numbers describe the same feature. Expanded, it exceeds strict sizer boxes, so treat the expansion as something you open on the return leg after checking your airline's tolerance.

highlights.title: Wheels are the part that fails first
highlights.body: The Travelpro holds first at 8.9 largely on a 9.8 mobility score, because wheel bearings and housings take the abuse that ends most suitcases. Check whether replacement wheels are sold for the model you buy, since a bag with available spares outlives one where a seized wheel means a new case.

On sizing, measure with the wheels and handle included, because that is how gate agents measure. A bag advertised as 21 inches that measures 23 with wheels will be gate checked on a full flight, and the airlines enforcing sizers most strictly are the budget carriers where the fee hurts most.

Soft-side bags with a front pocket win under the new battery rules. Keep the packs where you can reach them.
